title: Staff Product Manager, Pricing and Manufacturability
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.</p></div><p>Every quote Xometry generates in Europe depends on getting two things right at once: an accurate read on manufacturability and a price that wins the job without leaving margin on the table. As Staff Product Manager for Pricing, you will own the strategy and roadmap for how Xometry prices and evaluates manufacturability across the EMEA region — a technical, cross-functional, high-ownership role at the intersection of pricing strategy, manufacturing domain expertise, and applied AI.</p> <p><strong>How You’ll Contribute:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Vision &amp; strategy: Define and drive a multi-year roadmap for pricing and manufacturability in Europe, translating regional market dynamics, competitive positioning, and customer behavior into a pricing strategy that accelerates sales growth without sacrificing margin discipline.</li> <li>Own the Intelligent DFM Workbench: Lead the systems and models that determine how Xometry prices custom parts across European markets — identifying where pricing is too slow, too rigid, or too disconnected from true manufacturability cost, and closing those gaps.</li> <li>Extend Xometry's global AI capabilities into Europe: Partner with global product, data science, and ML engineering teams to adapt and scale Xometry's AI-driven pricing and manufacturability solutions for the European region — geometry-based cost estimation, manufacturability scoring, and pricing optimization models — rather than building parallel, region-specific tooling.</li> <li>Drive measurable outcomes: Define and track the metrics that matter for the region — win rate, price realization, quote-to-order conversion, margin accuracy, and manufacturability sign-off latency — and use them to prioritize the roadmap.</li> <li>Lead cross-functionally: Act as the hub between Sales, Sourcing, Data Science, Engineering, and regional leadership across Europe, and present strategy, trade-offs, and ROI to executive leadership both regionally and globally.</li> <li>Represent Europe in global strategy: Ensure European market realities — currency, competitive landscape, regulatory nuance, regional manufacturing capacity — shape Xometry's global pricing and AI product direction, rather than being retrofitted after the fact.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You'll Bring to Xometry:</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of product management experience, including leading AI/ML-powered or technical products in a B2B, marketplace, or manufacturing/engineering environment</li> <li>Experience owning a system of record or complex data contract (e.g., a shared record consumed by multiple downstream systems and roles) and the human-in-the-loop workflows built around it</li> <li>Experience designing policy-driven workflows (e.g., approval routing, tiered sign-off, escalation logic) rather than single-user tools</li> <li>Comfort operating across regions and stakeholder groups to hold a single global design standard, despite real pressure to add customizations</li> <li>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill technical and operational complexity into a clear narrative for engineers and executives alike</li> <li>Rigorous, data-driven approach to prioritization, experimentation, and measuring impact on cycle time, quality, and customer/partner satisfaction</li> <li>Familiarity with manufacturing processes and DFM principles (CNC machining, sheet metal, additive manufacturing, injection molding) is a strong plus; comfort getting deep into geometry-based feasibility rules is required</li> <li>Track record partnering closely with data science and ML engineering teams to ship models into production — computer vision, 3D/geometric analysis, or applied LLM/VLM experience is a plus</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field; advanced degree (MBA, MS) a plus</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><div>&nbsp;</div> <div>Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>Please read our <a href="https://xometry.eu/en/policy/">privacy policy</a>&nbsp;here.&nbsp;</div></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Developer – Candy & Confectionery (All Genders)
description: YOU & AHEAD At ahead, we are on a mission to clean up the world’s candy drawers. We make the snacks everyone actually craves: chocolate bars, protein bars, wafers, cookies, gummies and more. Our products contain up to 90% less sugar with zero compromise on taste. We are a 130-person team based in Hamburg, with our own lab, a portfolio of more than 170 SKUs and ambitious growth plans across D2C, retail, Amazon and Europe. We are looking for a Senior Product Developer for Candy & Confectionery to own the technical development of our portfolio from the first brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up and launch. As our Senior Product Developer, you will bring technical depth to one of our most important categories and make sure every decision works in the real world: in the recipe, in the factory and in the customer’s hands. Are you a food developer who knows how to turn a great idea into a product people genuinely love? Someone who can balance taste, texture, stability, cost, compliance and timing while getting the product over the line? If you like taking ownership and enjoy solving real product problems, we would love to hear from you! YOUR TASKS End-to-End Product Development: You own candy and confectionery projects from brief to launch. You translate requirements into clear technical targets, develop and optimise formulations, oversee trials, sensory validation and technical decisions. Sugar Reduction & Product Performance: You develop reduced-sugar and no-added-sugar products without compromising on taste. You understand how ingredients affect texture, processing, stability and shelf life, and make clear trade-offs between quality, cost, compliance and speed. Sensory, Shelf Life & Scale-Up: You plan and coordinate sensory, shelf-life and stability testing. You prepare for pilot and industrial trials, work closely with co-manufacturers, troubleshoot issues and follow solutions through to production. Specifications, Suppliers & Compliance: You manage formulations, specifications, technical documentation, ingredients and samples. Together with our Quality team, you ensure that food law, labelling, allergen, nutritional and claims requirements are considered from the start. Cross-Functional Ownership: You work closely with Product, Quality, Operations, Procurement, Brand, Retail and Marketing. You communicate clearly, flag risks early, challenge assumptions and keep projects moving. Building Better NPD Processes: You document decisions and learnings, create clear handovers and help make product development more structured and predictable as ahead grows. YOUR PROFILE You bring 5+ years of experience in food product development, R&D, or NPD, with a track record from brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up, and launch. Hands-on experience in gummies, candy, chocolate, confectionery, or a related sweet-goods category is mandatory. You understand how taste, texture, processing, stability, shelf life, ingredients and production realities come together in a successful product. You have experience with sugar-reduction or no-added-sugar systems and know how to balance product performance with consumer expectations. You have worked with ingredient suppliers and co-manufacturers and have been involved in pilot or industrial-scale production. You are comfortable with specifications, technical documentation, and food-law requirements. You take ownership and follow through. You are structured without being bureaucratic, comfortable with ambiguity and willing to challenge a brief, assumption or timeline when needed. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and enjoy working as a senior individual contributor without direct reports initially. You hold a degree or equivalent training in food science, food technology, chemistry, nutrition science, ecotrophology, or a comparable field. You communicate confidently in German and English. WHAT MAKES YOUR PROFILE COMPLETE Experience launching 10+ food products, ideally across multiple markets. Experience working with gummies, candy, chocolate bars, cookies, filled confectionery or similar products. Strong knowledge of sugar reduction, sweetener systems, fibres and texture management. Experience planning, conducting or interpreting sensory tests, shelf-life studies and stability testing. Background in better-for-you food, functional food, private-label NPD, or a fast-growing consumer brand. Experience delivering products into D2C and retail channels across DACH or Europe. raw.description:

At ahead, we are on a mission to clean up the world’s candy drawers. We make the snacks everyone actually craves: chocolate bars, protein bars, wafers, cookies, gummies and more. Our products contain up to 90% less sugar with zero compromise on taste. We are a 130-person team based in Hamburg, with our own lab, a portfolio of more than 170 SKUs and ambitious growth plans across D2C, retail, Amazon and Europe.

We are looking for a Senior Product Developer for Candy & Confectionery to own the technical development of our portfolio from the first brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up and launch.

As our Senior Product Developer, you will bring technical depth to one of our most important categories and make sure every decision works in the real world: in the recipe, in the factory and in the customer’s hands.

Are you a food developer who knows how to turn a great idea into a product people genuinely love? Someone who can balance taste, texture, stability, cost, compliance and timing while getting the product over the line? If you like taking ownership and enjoy solving real product problems, we would love to hear from you! 


YOUR TASKS

  • End-to-End Product Development: You own candy and confectionery projects from brief to launch. You translate requirements into clear technical targets, develop and optimise formulations, oversee trials, sensory validation and technical decisions.

  • Sugar Reduction & Product Performance: You develop reduced-sugar and no-added-sugar products without compromising on taste. You understand how ingredients affect texture, processing, stability and shelf life, and make clear trade-offs between quality, cost, compliance and speed.

  • Sensory, Shelf Life & Scale-Up: You plan and coordinate sensory, shelf-life and stability testing. You prepare for pilot and industrial trials, work closely with co-manufacturers, troubleshoot issues and follow solutions through to production.

  • Specifications, Suppliers & Compliance: You manage formulations, specifications, technical documentation, ingredients and samples. Together with our Quality team, you ensure that food law, labelling, allergen, nutritional and claims requirements are considered from the start.

  • Cross-Functional Ownership: You work closely with Product, Quality, Operations, Procurement, Brand, Retail and Marketing. You communicate clearly, flag risks early, challenge assumptions and keep projects moving.

  • Building Better NPD Processes: You document decisions and learnings, create clear handovers and help make product development more structured and predictable as ahead grows.


YOUR PROFILE

  • You bring 5+ years of experience in food product development, R&D, or NPD, with a track record from brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up, and launch. Hands-on experience in gummies, candy, chocolate, confectionery, or a related sweet-goods category is mandatory.

You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and enjoy working as a senior individual contributor without direct reports initially.

  • Experience launching 10+ food products, ideally across multiple markets.

title: Applied AI Scientist(m/f/d)
description: About us NET CHECK GmbH was founded in 1999 with the aim of improving the quality of communication networks. Since then, NET CHECK has developed into the leading partner of network operators and infrastructure providers of mobile and fixed networks of all technologies. Its core competencies include international network benchmarking (comparative measurements) as well as network planning and fault analysis. NET CHECK has one of Germany's largest crowdsourcing platforms, which generates over 144 million data points every day. Our commitment to quality and security has earned us the trust of scientific and government institutions. NET CHECK is headquartered in Berlin and is part of the NC GROUP, an owner-managed group of companies with a total of over 180 employees at five locations in Germany and one in Belgrade, Serbia. Job Summary: We build AI platforms that transform complex telecom network data—including drive tests, voice quality, broadband diagnostics, and signaling analysis—into clear, actionable insights. We are looking for an Applied AI Scientist who combines strong analytical thinking with practical engineering skills. You will model complex problems, develop and prototype ML and agentic AI solutions, and turn them into reliable, production-ready tools for real users while applying the latest developments in AI. Responsibilities Design and build agentic AI systems and RAG pipelines that can reason over technical documentation and live network data. Take ownership of testing and evaluation by developing evaluation datasets, metrics, and benchmarks for accuracy, retrieval quality, latency, and cost. Ensure system quality can be measured reliably and regressions are identified before reaching users. Develop and continuously improve our evaluation and observability practices, including offline and online evaluations, LLM-as-a-judge approaches where appropriate, regression testing, and quality dashboards for agentic AI and RAG systems. Turn data science insights into production-ready solutions, covering the full process from data analysis and modeling to well-tested, maintainable AI tools, including operationalization and MLOps. Develop and enhance machine learning models for classification, anomaly detection, root-cause analysis, and related use cases, and integrate them into the platform. Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code, actively contributing to high engineering standards across the team. Research and experiment with new AI models, methods, and technologies, turning promising approaches into practical features and production solutions. Work closely with engineers, data specialists, and domain experts to develop effective solutions for real-world telecom challenges. Your profile PhD in a quantitative discipline such as Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Computational Chemistry/Biology, or a related natural science, with strong hands-on experience in mathematical and computational modeling. Minimum 3 years of experience developing software or machine learning systems in an industry or research environment, alongside or following your studies. Hands-on experience with AI agents and RAG, including building and implementing LLM-powered systems in practice. Strong background in data science and machine learning, with experience using tools and frameworks such as scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM, and deep learning frameworks. Strong software engineering and programming skills, particularly in Python, with a focus on clean, well-structured, tested, and maintainable code. Good understanding of the design and development of agentic AI systems, including orchestration, tools, memory, evaluation, and guardrails. title: Senior Process Engieer
description: ABOUT US tozero is Europe’s leading deep-tech startup specializing in the recycling of lithium-ion batteries. Committed to accelerating decarbonization and transforming the material life cycle, we’re actively crafting sustainable recycling solutions for a cleaner and more innovative future. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer to take a leading technical role in the design, scale-up, commissioning and ramp up of our battery recycling processes. This role sits at the intersection of technology development, process engineering, and industrial scale-up. You will translate experimental and operational data into robust process designs, challenge engineering assumptions, and ensure that our future plants are built on solid fundamentals. Your focus will be on the processes that matter most to our technology — graphite and lithium extraction. By working closely with R&D, Operations and external engineering partners, you will actively lead and engage in activities associated with: a) engineering design; b) commissioning and ramp up; c) process development. We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a production environment, but who can also take a step back and understand what the data is telling us, and engineer the process we need at different scales. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Must Have's: 1. Future Plant Design & Scale-up ● Own key process design activities for our next-generation plants. ● Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process descriptions and equipment specifications for future capacity expansions. ● Translate pilot and industrial operating data into reliable engineering design criteria and scale-up assumptions. ● Perform process calculations and equipment sizing to ensure our future plants are designed based on validated engineering data rather than theoretical assumptions alone. 2. Targeted Process Expertise & Optimization ● Become a technical reference for some of our most critical process steps. ● Apply strong chemical engineering fundamentals to the optimization of graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing. ● Identify the parameters controlling yield, purity and process stability and translate these insights into concrete process improvements. ● Work closely with R&D and Operations while maintaining a strong focus on process performance and technology development rather than daily troubleshooting. 3. Data Analysis & Process Modeling ● Turn plant data into engineering decisions. ● Evaluate operational and experimental data, build and validate mass balances and process models, and identify gaps between expected and actual process performance. ● Define what data needs to be collected to support future scale-up decisions. ● Technically guide data analysts and other engineering functions to ensure that models and analytics remain grounded in physical and chemical reality. ● Translate analysis into clear recommendations for process upgrades and future plant designs. 4. Commissioning & Process Validation ● Make sure what we designed actually works. ● Participate in FATs/SATs, commissioning activities and process performance validation for new equipment and plant expansions. ● Develop acceptance and process validation criteria based on the original design intent. ● Evaluate commissioning and operational data to confirm that installed systems achieve their calculated performance targets. ● Work closely with Operations during handover while ensuring clear ownership transfers once the process meets its design criteria. 5. Operational Readiness, Process Safety & SOPs ● Design processes that can be operated safely and consistently. ● Translate process design and engineering intent into clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operating envelopes and process documentation. ● Participate actively in HAZOPs, LOPAs, and other process safety reviews, ensuring that process risks are identified and addressed during design rather than after installation. ● Support Operations in understanding the design basis and critical process parameters of newly commissioned systems. Nice-to-have's: Vendor & EPC Coordination ● Represent tozero's process requirements with external engineering partners and equipment suppliers. ● Prepare and review technical specifications, vendor proposals and engineering documentation. ● Challenge unsupported assumptions, identify over-engineered solutions and ensure equipment is correctly sized for our process. ● Support technical bid evaluations and equipment selection, balancing process performance, CAPEX, operability and scalability. ● Act as a strong technical counterpart to EPCs, engineering contractors and equipment vendors throughout project execution. Your profile You have a strong chemical/process engineering foundation and enjoy solving technically complex problems with a combination of first-principles engineering and real plant data. ● Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering or a related technical field. ● Ideally 5+ years of experience in process engineering within the chemical, hydrometallurgy, battery, mining, minerals, recycling or related process industries; specific expertise in graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing is highly preferred. ● Strong experience with process design and scale-up, including PFDs, P&IDs, mass/energy balances and equipment sizing. ● Comfortable working with industrial datasets and translating operational data into engineering models and decisions. ● Experience with solid-liquid separation, precipitation, flotation, hydrometallurgy or mineral processing is highly valuable. ● Able to critically review vendor proposals and confidently challenge technical assumptions. ● Strong experience supporting commissioning and process validation of industrial equipment or plants. ● Familiarity with process safety methodologies such as HAZOP and LOPA. ● Comfortable moving between detailed calculations, engineering documentation and the actual plant. ● Strong communicator who can work effectively across R&D, Engineering, Operations, suppliers and EPC partners. ● Fluent English; German is a plus. Why us? Our technology is moving from first-of-a-kind industrial operations toward increasingly larger and more standardized plants. The Senior Process Engineer will help us make that transition successfully: turning what we learn from today's plant into the engineering basis for tomorrow's plants while supporting commissioning and ramping up efforts. You will directly influence process performance, equipment selection, CAPEX and the technical architecture of our future facilities — helping ensure that every new scale is safer, simpler, more efficient and better engineered than the one before it.   • Bewertung und Einführung geeigneter Technologien, Frameworks und Architekturansätze

  • Bewertung und Einsatz innovativer Technologien wie KI zur Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Lösungen

DAS IST UNS WICHTIG

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse moderner Softwarearchitekturen sowie Erfahrung mit Java-/JEE-basierten Enterprise-Anwendungen

  • Erfahrung in der technischen Konzeption komplexer Anwendungssysteme sowie mit Integrations- und Schnittstellenarchitekturen, z. B. REST oder SOAP

  • Erfahrung mit Cloud- und Container-Technologien wie Kubernetes, OpenShift oder Docker

  • Fundierte Erfahrung im Umfeld der gesetzlichen Krankenversicherung (GKV) und ein gutes Verständnis für die Anforderungen des Gesundheitswesens

  • Kenntnisse im Umgang mit sensiblen Daten sowie regulatorischen Anforderungen in einem entsprechend geschützten Umfeld

Nice to have:

Job Overview

Solactive's Aggregate team owns the intraday calculation of our indices: consuming live price streams, applying calculation logic across a wide range of indices, and producing a continuous output stream of index ticks throughout the trading day. The core platform is built in Java and engineered around throughput, latency, and correctness under concurrency, while custom business integrations are built in Python. As a Working Student you join a small team and contribute real, production-bound code to both, working alongside senior engineers who review your work and coach you.


Your Tasks

  • Implement well-scoped features and fixes in the Java calculation platform, such as improvements to calculation components, price stream consumption, or index tick production
  • Write unit, integration, and performance tests, including tests for concurrent code paths where ordering and timing matter
  • Help investigate correctness or performance issues: reproduce them, narrow them down, and propose fixes with senior guidance
  • Build and maintain Python integrations for business teams: connectors to the calculation platform, output adapters, validation checks, and small operational tools
  • Contribute to monitoring and developer tooling that makes calculation behaviour observable and easier to reason about

  • Familiarity with Git, the command line, and a testing mindset; interest in measuring performance rather than guessing at it
  • Ability to work independently on a scoped task, ask for help early when stuck, and communicate clearly in writing
  • Available for 15–20 hours per week during the semester, more during semester breaks
  • Interest in financial markets, market data, or index calculation is welcome but not required

You act as a trusted sparring partner to executives, steer complex transformation programs across functions, and bridge the gap between technical possibilities and business imperatives. You support our business growth by contributing to lead conversion, proposal writing, and pre-sales activities with entrepreneurial energy. With a strong presence and an opinionated point of view, you represent Merantix Momentum’s AI Transformation perspective externally through expert discussions, LinkedIn content, and thought leadership in our core verticals. Internally, you contribute to the continuous development of our AI Transformation offering by evolving expertise, methods, and tools, leading by example with a fast-paced, can-do attitude and high degree of self-assurance. Advance the AI Transformation practice: Evolve our methodologies, tools, and frameworks to keep our offering state-of-the-art and to develop reusable transformation playbooks, bringing in consulting or domain expertise into the team. Enable Colleagues: Advise colleagues on AI transformation best practices by leading project teams, sharing lessons learned, and contributing to a fast-paced, can-do culture. When applying please include a cover letter explaining your fit and motivation for this role as AI Transformation Manager. Your profile At our heart, we remain a startup and define ourselves by a culture of ownership and cooperation. We are looking for driven, capable, and prudent talents with a strong motivation and hunger for new challenges and opportunities to learn and grow. You are a team player and willing to learn, support and grow in a team and as a company. Preferably 8+ years of full-time working experience in management consulting, enterprise technology, AI/ML-driven companies, or other fast-paced environments like leading startups and boutique consulting firms. Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional transformation programs with the ability to manage executive stakeholders and drive organizational change. Strong fluency in advising on AI, orchestrating its build, operating a model allowing organizations to scale AI, and enabling management to make the right investments. Knowledgeable about common machine learning techniques and trends; experience in AI use case conceptualization and assessing technical feasibility. Demonstrated experience in change management and embedding AI capabilities within client organizations. Curiosity to constantly explore and learn about new AI solutions at the intersection of technology and business. Great communication skills in German and English. We are an international and diverse team always supporting and challenging each other to get out the best in each of us. Become part of the entire Merantix ecosystem at the AI Campus in Berlin and join us on transforming the European AI landscape. Engaging Topics and Excellence: Merantix offers unique insights into applied machine learning research and development, working with a group of highly talented engineers, researchers and entrepreneurs Dynamic working culture: We hold weekly and monthly events around AI Innovation and Implementation. We have a flat hierarchy, open 360° feedback, and flexible working hours. We have a flexible work-from-home policy but you are very welcome to work from our office situated on the AI Campus in Berlin. Learning and Development: Individual learning and development budget to attend conferences or purchase educational resources to further develop additional skills. Extra amount of vacation for Learning and Development. Ethics: We are committed to developing ethical AI software. Hardware allowance: We give you support to have all the equipment you would need to thrive on your job. Sabbatical Leave. You will take ideas from zero to one and help scale proven businesses from one to one hundred. This role is designed for an ambitious recent graduate or early-career strategy consultant who wants to move from advising businesses to building them. You will operate with high autonomy, turn ambiguous opportunities into clear choices, and help launch ventures that can become meaningful parts of Taxfix’s future. Your team You will join our New Ventures function and work closely with Taxfix’s C-level leadership and Management Team. Depending on the opportunity, you will collaborate with colleagues across Product, Commercial, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Tax. Move beyond presentations by building prototypes, coordinating pilots, acquiring initial customers, and establishing the foundations for launch. Turn validated ventures into scalable businesses by developing repeatable growth engines, robust operating models, strong teams, and performance management systems. Translate complex analysis into concise, decision-ready recommendations for the C-level team, Leadership Team, and Board. Mobilise colleagues across Product, Commercial, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Tax to move ventures forward. Your profile You have a hands-on builder mentality and do not wait for perfect resources or specialist support. You use AI-native tools and vibe coding to rapidly build prototypes, automate workflows, analyse data, and turn ideas into tangible products and experiments—even if you are not a software engineer by training. You are a recent graduate from a leading university or business school, such as WHU, HHL, HSG, HEC, ESADE, or a comparable institution; alternatively, you have up to two or three years of experience at a leading strategy consultancy such as McKinsey, BCG, Bain, or a comparable firm. You can break ambiguous questions down into hypotheses, analyses, experiments, and clear decisions. You combine strategic depth with a strong bias for action. You are willing to speak with customers, build a model, test a landing page, or solve an operational bottleneck yourself. You understand what creates customer value and can connect it to pricing, unit economics, distribution, and scalable operations. This role demands a leader who can combine structured organisation and process building, relentless deal execution and strong coaching with domain adaptability.

You will:

  • Lead, coach, and develop Account Executives across UK, Luxembourg and Germany.

  • Set a high bar for sales quality, customer understanding, pipeline discipline, commercial judgment, and performance

  • Define and execute market-by-market sales plans in close partnership with the leadership team

  • Build a predictable sales operating cadence across pipeline reviews, forecasting, deal inspection, CRM discipline, and conversion tracking

  • Set up scalable sales processes across the full funnel — from lead routing, qualification, discovery, mutual action plans, pricing, proposal creation, negotiation, handover, and post-sale feedback loops

  • Own the commercial operating system: CRM hygiene, reporting, dashboarding, pipeline definitions, stage exit criteria, forecasting methodology, activity tracking, and tooling adoption

  • Create and maintain sales handbooks, enablement materials, talk tracks, qualification guides, objection-handling resources, market playbooks, and deal review templates so the team has a clear source of truth

  • Build a regular coaching rhythm through call reviews, deal reviews, pipeline inspection, 1:1s, performance feedback, and structured development plans

  • Stay close to strategic deals where customer trust, market context, executive engagement, or commercial judgment are critical

  • Partner closely with other teams, including Marketing, Customer Success, Product Development, Operations, Legal & Finance, and our Co-Founders to advance commercial outcomes

  • Bring structured market feedback into company planning, including customer needs, competitor patterns, pricing insights, product gaps, and operational blockers

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition to hire, onboard, ramp, and manage performance as the sales team expands

About you

  • You have proven experience navigating commercial models that blend scalable software/SaaS with high-touch services, implementation, or customer operations, understanding how to price, position, and transition complex deals without eroding margins.

  • Extensive B2B commercial experience with proven success closing complex, consultative enterprise software or tech-enabled service deals.

  • Direct experience selling into venture capital, private equity, asset management, or fund services is a strong plus, but your ability to build a high-performing tech sales motion comes first.

  • You have a track record of driving sales motions for high-ticket solutions where deal sizes are consistently in the hundreds of thousands, focusing on relationship-driven, consultative outcomes.

  • You have 3+ years of experience directly managing, coaching, and scaling Account Executives teams, with a clear track record of raising team performance, enforcing pipeline discipline, and driving revenue growth.

  • You have coached team members through long-cycle, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals

  • You have successfully built and scaled sales motions across multiple markets, driving high performance through rigorous CRM discipline, RevOps tooling, and predictable forecasting routines.

  • You excel at creating practical sales handbooks, enablement resources, playbooks, and coaching frameworks that teams rely on to drive complex, long-cycle enterprise deals.

  • You are a seasoned people leader who sets a high bar for excellence, fostering talent through direct feedback, clear performance management, and structured coaching.

  • You combine strong commercial judgment—knowing when to push or qualify out—with the executive presence to build trust and credibility with senior stakeholders.

  • You have a builder mentality and are comfortable creating structure in an environment that is still scaling

  • You communicate excellently in English

Existing understanding of VC / PE fund operations, GP / LP structures, fund administration, investor onboarding, transfer agency, or Luxembourg fund structures is a strong plus.

What success looks like

In your first months, you will build a clear understanding of bunch’s commercial motion, ICP, product, implementation model, pricing, and market dynamics. You will establish trust with the existing sales team, founders, and key cross-functional partners, while introducing a clear cadence for pipeline reviews, deal coaching, forecasting, and performance visibility.

Over time, you will strengthen the team’s execution across priority markets, improve pipeline quality and forecast accuracy, standardise the sales playbook, support hiring and onboarding, and build stronger cross-functional routines with Marketing, Solutions, Operations, Customer Success, Product, and RevOps. You will also establish the core sales infrastructure the team needs to scale: clear funnel processes, reliable CRM workflows, useful dashboards, practical handbooks, repeatable coaching routines, and a shared source of truth for how we sell.

Ultimately, you will help build a high-performing and scalable sales organisation across UK, Luxembourg and Germany, improving predictable revenue generation and constantly raising the quality bar for complex private-markets selling.

Du arbeitest an einem Produkt mit echter Marktdurchdringung in einem riesigen DACH-Mittelstandsmarkt, lieferst Ergebnisse iterativ und übernimmst Ownership für Lösungen, die in der Praxis funktionieren müssen und nicht nur im Konzept. Je nach Erfahrung, Dealgröße und Komplexität führst du eigenständig schnelle Abschlüsse oder steuerst anspruchsvollere Sales-Prozesse in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Head of Sales oder den Foundern. Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für die Anforderungen unserer Kund:innen, berätst lösungsorientiert und baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf. Dabei arbeitest du strukturiert und datengetrieben, pflegst Deals und Aktivitäten zuverlässig in HubSpot und nutzt Forecasts sowie KPIs als Grundlage für Transparenz und Planbarkeit. Die Herausforderung Unsere Kund:innen entscheiden sehr wirtschaftlich – umso wichtiger ist es, den Nutzen unserer Plattform in klare, nachvollziehbare Zahlen zu übersetzen: weniger manueller Aufwand, weniger rechtliches Risiko, messbare Kostenersparnis. Ein SaaS-Abo folgt dabei einer anderen Logik als eine klassische Investitionsentscheidung, und du hilfst dabei, diesen Mehrwert verständlich zu machen. Weil Dealgröße und Komplexität von Fall zu Fall variieren, wechselst du zwischen schnellem Abschluss und mehrstufigem Prozess – und sorgst trotzdem für verlässliches Forecasting. Deine Aufgaben Du übernimmst qualifizierte Leads vom BDR-Team und führst passgenaue Demos für unterschiedliche Stakeholder – vom Einkauf bis zur Geschäftsführung. Du managst diese unterschiedlichen Stakeholder über den gesamten Sales-Cycle hinweg und sorgst dafür, dass alle Beteiligten eingebunden bleiben und an einem Strang ziehen. Du baust Vertrauen auf, indem du Erfahrungen unserer Referenzkund:innen teilst – darunter 14 der Top-20-Bauunternehmen Deutschlands – da persönliche Beziehungen und Referenzen in der Baubranche besonders viel zählen. Du verhandelst Konditionen und Verträge – eigenständig oder mit dem Head of Sales – und behältst dabei die rechtssichere Dokumentenverarbeitung als zentrales Verkaufsargument im Blick. Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss übergibst du strukturiert an Customer Success, damit der Start für neue Kund:innen reibungslos verläuft. Du nutzt AI-Tools wie Copilot, Claude und Cursor, um Angebote und Präsentationen effizienter vorzubereiten. Du schließt Deals unterschiedlicher Größe selbstständig ab, von schnellen Abschlüssen bis zu anspruchsvollen Projekten. Du arbeitest sehr strukturiert und sauber, nutzt HubSpot oder vergleichbare CRM-Systeme exzellent und überzeugst durch klare, lösungsorientierte Kommunikation. Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und Englisch fließend. Du lebst in oder in der Nähe von München und bist bereit, 2-3 Tage pro Woche im Büro präsent zu sein. title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Data Intelligence Applications (m/f/d)
description: At Statista , we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions. Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees. We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team. Are you ready to join us? About the Role You will own and build the customer-facing layer of our platform: a portfolio of data intelligence products for hospitals, as well as the shared application framework beneath them. As the senior technical lead for this area, you will operate with high agency—designing how data is queried, cached, and visualized, building API layers over platform services, and working directly with domain experts to translate complex methodology into intuitive, high-impact products. Key Responsibilities End-to-End Product Ownership: Architect, build, and maintain data intelligence applications from database query contracts down to interactive UI components. Framework & API Layer: Build and own the shared application API layer, composing underlying platform services and published data models into stable contracts. Data-Access & Performance Strategy: Design robust caching, materialization, pagination, and streaming patterns to serve complex analytics from cloud data warehouses with low latency and optimized compute cost. Advanced Data Visualization: Build interactive, non-standard visualization interfaces (e.g., hospital performance benchmarking and peer comparison views) and establish reusable patterns for the broader portfolio. AI-Mediated Interfaces: Implement natural language and LLM-driven application surfaces—including retrieval workflows, tool integration, structured outputs, streaming, and evaluation of latency and cost. Technical Leadership: Shape application architecture, set engineering standards, drive testing discipline, and mentor joining engineers. Qualifications Core Requirements (Must-Haves) Full-Stack TypeScript: Deep production experience across both client (React / Next.js) and server (Node.js using Fastify, Express, or NestJS). Advanced Data Visualization: Hands-on experience building custom, interactive visualizations (working with scales, layouts, coordinate systems directly using D3.js alongside Visx, ECharts, or Vega-Lite) and choosing appropriate render targets (SVG, Canvas, WebGL). Analytical SQL & Warehouse Caching: Strong analytical SQL skills (window functions, CTEs, multi-level aggregations) and practical experience designing materialization/caching strategies over columnar cloud warehouses. Praktikum Commercial Operations & Account Management

Ab sofort in München.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Wir wollen die erste Anlaufstelle für den Autowechsel werden. Mit einer Kombination aus Technologie, Medien und tiefem Verständnis für den Automobilsektor haben wir schon jetzt die Art wie Menschen Autos (ver)kaufen, vermarkten und leasen, auf den Kopf gestellt.

Was als einfache Neuwagen-Vergleichsplattform begann, ist heute einer der größten Online-Marktplätze für den Autowechsel in Europa. Im letzten Jahr allein sind wir dabei mit Fahrzeugen, die im Wert von über £3bn über unser Portal gekauft, geleast oder versteigert wurden, um über 50% gewachsen.

2024 haben wir mit der Übernahme von Autovia – der Plattform hinter AutoExpress und dem Evo Magazin – anschließend unsere Reichweite über Nacht verdoppelt. Zusammen zählen wir nun mit fast 10 Mio. Abonnenten und 1,1 Mrd. jährlichen Aufrufen zu den größten YouTube-Kanälen der Welt. Daneben verkaufen wir 1,2 Mio. Kopien unseres Print-Magazins und erreichen jährlich über 350 Mio. Menschen mit unserem Web-Content.

Und wir sind noch lange nicht fertig.

Our in-house developed 4X MMO was launched in 2018 and continues to evolve, being consistently one of the top grossing Massive Multiplayer Strategy games on the market.</p> <p>At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.</p> <h3>What You Will Do</h3> <p>As the Senior Product Manager<strong>, </strong>you will be the product owner for key monetisation and engagement initiatives across the live game. This includes driving the roadmap and execution of our monthly content releases, ensuring they are cohesive, compelling, and highly performant. You will work cross-functionally with Game Design, Product Marketing, Product Ops, Economy Design, and Data Science teams to define, prioritise, and deliver exceptional player experiences that meet business and player goals.</p> <ul> <li>Own the content and performance strategy for our monthly releases, aligning them to player motivations, economic balance, and business KPIs</li> <li>Define and manage the monthly content calendar, collaborating with Design, Production, and Engineering to deliver high-quality, on-time experiences</li> <li>Use data and experimentation to optimise monetisation, engagement, and retention across a broad player lifecycle—from new users to end-game whales</li> <li>Deeply understand player behaviour across multiple geos and platforms to ensure we deliver value through personalisation and segmentation strategies</li> <li>Work closely with the economy and systems design teams to ensure content aligns with long-term progression goals and avoids inflation</li> <li>Partner with UX, Research, and Community teams to develop empathy for player sentiment and pain points, and translate them into actionable product improvements</li> <li>Build business cases for major new initiatives and content verticals, including competitive research and revenue forecasting</li> <li>Mentor junior PMs and contribute to a culture of product excellence and cross-functional collaboration.</li> </ul> <h3>What We're Looking For</h3> <ul> <li>Extensive experience in product management, ideally with significant responsibility on a F2P mobile game</li> <li>Demonstrated success managing complex monetisation and engagement systems, with extensive experience in content development</li> <li>Data-native mindset, with the ability to translate raw performance metrics into strategic insights and actionable plans</li> <li>Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a proven track record of aligning diverse teams around a shared product vision</li> <li>Strong player empathy and experience working with user research, community feedback, or other voice-of-player channels</li> <li>Experience driving impact across cross-functional pods, including creative, design, and engineering teams</li> </ul> <p>At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that!&nbsp; We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us &amp; embrace the adventure!</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>About Scopely</h3> <p>Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.</p> <p>Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.</p> <p>Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.</p> <p>Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/">https://www.scopely.com/</a>.&nbsp;</p> <p>Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. In short We're looking for a Video Lead to shoot and edit for tem. Full-time, £70,000, based anywhere in the UK with shoots around the country. tem connects businesses directly with the renewable generators that power them, which makes it an unusually diverse thing to film: solar and wind sites, the people who run them, the businesses buying from them, and the engineers building the technology in between. Here's some of what we've made so far: here , here , here and here . The work we want to make Two kinds of video, held to the same standard. Considered films, where pacing, sound and framing carry the story and every shot is there for a reason. The kind someone who has never thought about energy watches to the end, because they've started to care about the person in it. And social pieces that aren't templates: short cuts made with real intent, where the rhythm, timing, sound design and effects all serve the idea. Native to the platform, unmistakably crafted. You'll move between the two in the same week without either one slipping. If you're freelance - most of the best shooter-editors work for themselves, and we understand why. Here's what we'd want you to know. This isn't corporate video. Generator stories, customer films, policy explainers, engineering pieces and people-led series - a social series one week, a customer film the next. When it's worth moving fast, we can go from idea to published within a week, if that’s what we collectively decide. You'd be building something, not borrowing it. Rather than picking up someone else's style for a few weeks, you'd shape what tem's video looks and feels like, and build a body of work around it over years. You're expected, and encouraged, to argue when you see a better way. Fewer feedback rounds. One brand, one small team, and a direct line to whoever wrote the brief. You learn tem once, properly. The money. £70,000, stock options, paid holiday, and no invoices to chase or quiet months to plan around. What you'll own tem's video from first shot to final export: how it's planned, shot and cut, and how it looks and sounds across everything we publish. You'll sit in the Brand team and report into the Content Lead. Shoots. Planning properly - schedule, kit, shot list, a recce where it's worth it - then staying alert on the day for what the plan couldn't know. Running most shoots solo, and knowing when a piece needs extra crew and when a phone and good instincts will do. People. Most of the generators, engineers and finance directors you'll film have never been on camera. Putting them at ease and getting the real version of them is half the job. The edit (around 70% of your week). Cutting, grading, mixing and titling in Premiere Pro. Giving short social pieces the same care as the long ones, letting the considered films breathe, and making something good from very little when there's no shoot. Story and style. Turning a brief or rough idea into how it should be shot and sequenced, pushing back when you see a better version, and developing a visual language for tem video over time. How we use AI (and how we don't) We're not looking for someone to make AI-generated films - our content works because it's real. We use tools where they earn their place: transcription and paper edits, selects, audio clean-up, subtitles, cutdowns and versioning, the occasional fix in post, and pre-production like moodboards and storyboards. We want someone curious enough to try new tools, with the judgement to know when not to. What we're looking for Must haves A portfolio, wherever it lives, that shows both halves: considered, human storytelling and social work cut with real intent. A professional standard at both shooting and editing. Speed without losing control. The ability to plan and run a shoot yourself. Good with people, on and off camera. Sensible, hands-on use of AI tools in a real pipeline. UK-based and happy to travel for shoots. Bonus points Premiere Pro, since it's what we cut in. Colour, sound design or motion graphics beyond the basics. A freelance or small-studio background. An interest in energy, climate or tech. What you get £70,000 salary, reviewed twice a year. raw.title: Video Lead
raw.description:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

In short

We're looking for a Video Lead to shoot and edit for tem. Full-time, £70,000, based anywhere in the UK with shoots around the country.

tem connects businesses directly with the renewable generators that power them, which makes it an unusually diverse thing to film: solar and wind sites, the people who run them, the businesses buying from them, and the engineers building the technology in between. Here's some of what we've made so far: here, here, here and here.

The work we want to make

Two kinds of video, held to the same standard.

Considered films, where pacing, sound and framing carry the story and every shot is there for a reason. The kind someone who has never thought about energy watches to the end, because they've started to care about the person in it.

And social pieces that aren't templates: short cuts made with real intent, where the rhythm, timing, sound design and effects all serve the idea. Native to the platform, unmistakably crafted.

You'll move between the two in the same week without either one slipping.

If you're freelance - most of the best shooter-editors work for themselves, and we understand why. Here's what we'd want you to know.

This isn't corporate video. Generator stories, customer films, policy explainers, engineering pieces and people-led series - a social series one week, a customer film the next. When it's worth moving fast, we can go from idea to published within a week, if that’s what we collectively decide.

You'd be building something, not borrowing it. Rather than picking up someone else's style for a few weeks, you'd shape what tem's video looks and feels like, and build a body of work around it over years. You're expected, and encouraged, to argue when you see a better way.

Fewer feedback rounds. One brand, one small team, and a direct line to whoever wrote the brief. You learn tem once, properly.

The money. £70,000, stock options, paid holiday, and no invoices to chase or quiet months to plan around.

What you'll own

tem's video from first shot to final export: how it's planned, shot and cut, and how it looks and sounds across everything we publish. You'll sit in the Brand team and report into the Content Lead.

  • Shoots. Planning properly - schedule, kit, shot list, a recce where it's worth it - then staying alert on the day for what the plan couldn't know. Running most shoots solo, and knowing when a piece needs extra crew and when a phone and good instincts will do.

  • People. Most of the generators, engineers and finance directors you'll film have never been on camera. Putting them at ease and getting the real version of them is half the job.

  • The edit (around 70% of your week). Cutting, grading, mixing and titling in Premiere Pro. Giving short social pieces the same care as the long ones, letting the considered films breathe, and making something good from very little when there's no shoot.

  • Story and style. Turning a brief or rough idea into how it should be shot and sequenced, pushing back when you see a better version, and developing a visual language for tem video over time.

How we use AI (and how we don't)

We're not looking for someone to make AI-generated films - our content works because it's real. We use tools where they earn their place: transcription and paper edits, selects, audio clean-up, subtitles, cutdowns and versioning, the occasional fix in post, and pre-production like moodboards and storyboards. We want someone curious enough to try new tools, with the judgement to know when not to.

What we're looking for

Must haves

  • A portfolio, wherever it lives, that shows both halves: considered, human storytelling and social work cut with real intent.

  • A professional standard at both shooting and editing.

  • Speed without losing control.

  • The ability to plan and run a shoot yourself.

  • Good with people, on and off camera.

  • Sensible, hands-on use of AI tools in a real pipeline.

  • UK-based and happy to travel for shoots.

Bonus points

  • Premiere Pro, since it's what we cut in.

  • Colour, sound design or motion graphics beyond the basics.

  • A freelance or small-studio background.

  • An interest in energy, climate or tech.

What you get

  • £70,000 salary, reviewed twice a year.

  • Your say in what video kit we invest in for the content team.

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays (swap them for the ones that matter to you), and your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Up to £1,200 a year for your remote setup and £150 a month for wellbeing.

How to apply

  • Send us your work. Your portfolio plus two recent pieces, with a line on what you did on each via the application form.

  • A 30-minute conversation with Alex (Content Lead) and Chelsea.

  • A paid, one-hour edit challenge. We send you unreleased tem footage, you cut it, and we talk through your choices. Everyone who delivers an edit at this stage is paid £200, hired or not - we don't think ideas should be taken for free.

  • A final conversation with leadership.

The assurance calendar - Maintain the annual calendar of security activities and make sure each one happens, produces evidence, and closes its actions: penetration tests, access reviews, disaster recovery tests, tabletop exercises, policy reviews, supplier re-assessments, awareness training. - Coordinate external penetration tests: scoping, vendor selection, scheduling, findings triage, remediation tracking, retest. - Facilitate tabletop exercises, including scenario design and post-exercise action tracking. 4. Risk and control administration - Maintain the information security risk register: run the assessment cycle, record treatment plans with named owners and dates, chase closure. - Administer the policy exception and risk acceptance process, ensuring every exception is owned, time-bound and reviewed on expiry. - Perform first-line control testing: sample-test where key controls operate as designed and retain the evidence. - Produce security MI for the Head of Security to take to ExCo and the Risk Committee. 5. Vulnerability and findings management - Consolidate findings across sources — EDR, cloud security posture, SAST/DAST/SCA, secrets scanning, penetration tests — into a single view with agreed severity definitions and remediation SLAs. - Triage, route and chase remediation with engineering teams; escalate ageing findings. - Own the reporting on remediation performance. 6. Security awareness - Run the awareness programme: induction, annual refresher, phishing simulation, role-based training for engineers, completion tracking. - Coordinate pre-employment screening with People. What you will contribute to: - The ISO 27001 ISMS , which we are building towards certification. You will draft and maintain control documentation, populate the Statement of Applicability, gather evidence, coordinate the internal audit programme and be a primary point of contact for our external auditor. description: About The Role and Team Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more. Our Team Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph , BBC and the New Statesman . Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million. We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology. This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company. Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London). We are looking for a Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer to join our Process Integration team and play a key role in understanding, qualifying and improving the silicon devices at the heart of our quantum processors. You will sit at a fascinating intersection between semiconductor manufacturing and quantum hardware, working closely with foundries, process engineers and quantum engineers. You will use electrical characterisation and large-scale data analysis to understand manufacturing variability, identify the root causes of device behaviour, and feed those insights directly back into the semiconductor fabrication process. This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on the yield, quality and scalability of quantum processors, working with some of the most advanced silicon technology being developed for quantum computing. Functions of the Role Drive electrical characterisation of fabricated silicon devices , developing and continuously improving high-throughput screening methods to assess key device parameters including threshold voltage, gate oxide reliability and channel mobility. Turn electrical data into manufacturing insight , identifying patterns, variability and device failures and connecting them back to semiconductor process steps such as photolithography, etching, oxide growth, CMP and doping. Develop automated measurement and test infrastructure , creating robust Python-based test routines and instrument-control workflows across room-temperature and, where appropriate, low-temperature wafer probing environments. Analyse large-scale electrical datasets using statistical process control, yield analysis and other data-driven techniques to monitor wafer uniformity, defect density and process drift. Work directly with semiconductor foundries and process engineers , providing clear, actionable feedback that can be used to improve device performance, consistency and yield. Build scalable characterisation processes , establishing testing standards, calibration procedures, SOPs and data pipelines that allow information to flow effectively between semiconductor process integration and quantum engineering teams. Help shape how we characterise the next generation of our technology , bringing your expertise and ideas to continuously improve our measurement capability as Quantum Motion scales. We are looking for someone who combines strong semiconductor device knowledge with a practical, data-driven approach to electrical characterisation. Experience - Essentials Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics, Materials Science or a closely related discipline. 3+ years' experience in semiconductor device testing, reliability engineering, electrical characterisation or yield analysis within a foundry, IDM or semiconductor R&D environment. Strong understanding of silicon CMOS fabrication processes, semiconductor device physics and foundry workflows. Hands-on experience with semiconductor parameter analysers, SMUs and wafer probe stations, including DC and/or RF electrical testing. Strong Python skills, particularly for instrument control, automation and automated test execution. A highly analytical approach and the ability to work with large datasets to identify trends, anomalies and root causes. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across semiconductor, process, hardware and quantum engineering teams. Experience - Desirable It would be particularly valuable if you also have experience in: Quantum device physics, including quantum dots, single-electron transistors (SETs) or charge-stability mapping. Cryogenic electrical characterisation and low-temperature measurement systems. Semiconductor yield improvement, process control or statistical analysis. Automated wafer-level testing and high-throughput characterisation. Working with advanced or emerging semiconductor technologies. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

 

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. You will sit at a fascinating intersection between semiconductor manufacturing and quantum hardware, working closely with foundries, process engineers and quantum engineers.

You will use electrical characterisation and large-scale data analysis to understand manufacturing variability, identify the root causes of device behaviour, and feed those insights directly back into the semiconductor fabrication process.

This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on the yield, quality and scalability of quantum processors, working with some of the most advanced silicon technology being developed for quantum computing.


Functions of the Role

  • Drive electrical characterisation of fabricated silicon devices, developing and continuously improving high-throughput screening methods to assess key device parameters including threshold voltage, gate oxide reliability and channel mobility.

  • Develop automated measurement and test infrastructure, creating robust Python-based test routines and instrument-control workflows across room-temperature and, where appropriate, low-temperature wafer probing environments.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across semiconductor, process, hardware and quantum engineering teams.


Experience - Desirable

  • Quantum device physics, including quantum dots, single-electron transistors (SETs) or charge-stability mapping.

  • Cryogenic electrical characterisation and low-temperature measurement systems.

  • Semiconductor yield improvement, process control or statistical analysis.

description: <p><strong><u>The Role</u></strong></p> <p>We are seeking to hire an exceptional Director, Central Compliance &amp; Europe (“EU”) Regulatory Liaison, to join our London office. Reporting to the Deputy Chief Compliance Officer, this senior leader will manage a team of 3–4 compliance officers and hold responsibility for multiple Centers of Excellence (CoEs) within the firm's Central Compliance organization, spanning Financial Crime, Policy Management, and Core Compliance.</p> <p>In addition to leading these global CoEs, the role serves as the firm's senior point of contact for EU regulatory matters in each jurisdiction where Schonfeld is licensed or authorized. The position requires a strong combination of technical compliance expertise, operational and process discipline, and the proactive use of AI and technology to drive efficiency across the function.</p> <p><strong><u>What you'll do</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the firm's UK and larger EU Regulatory Liaison function, overseeing in-country Compliance Officers who act as SMEs and points of contact for local regulators, manage the local regulatory change agenda, and scope local requirements into the CoEs; sign off on local filings and registrations and engage in the expansion efforts of offices across Europe.</li> <li>Provide overall management, supervision, and strategic vision for multiple CoEs within Central Compliance, setting priorities, resourcing, and hiring plans, and adapting program design to regulatory and business change.</li> <li>Directly manage and develop a team of 3–4 compliance officers, providing leadership, mentorship, and performance management.</li> <li>Oversee the firm's Global/Regional AML Program, the Investor PEP/Sanctions screening process, and all AML/financial crime-related regulatory filings.</li> <li>Own the firm's Global Compliance Policies &amp; Procedures framework, including standardized P&amp;P templates, the P&amp;P Review Program, and regulator/client-facing policies.</li> <li>Administer the Code of Ethics Program end-to-end – including PA Dealing, Gifts &amp; Entertainment, Outside Business Interests, and Political Contributions – alongside Conflicts Management, Compliance Training, Licensing &amp; Registrations, Certifications, and Employee Administration.</li> <li>Champion the adoption of AI and compliance technology to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and scale program delivery.</li> <li>Be an integral and collaborative member of the London Compliance Team and the broader global Compliance department.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><u>What you'll bring</u></strong></p> <p><strong>What you need:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent; advanced degree (JD, MBA) preferred.</li> <li>Prrogressive compliance experience within financial services, with meaningful exposure to asset management, hedge funds, or investment advisory environments.</li> <li>Demonstrated leadership across multiple compliance disciplines (AML/financial crime, policy management, core compliance) with direct engagement with EU regulators such as the FCA.</li> <li>Proven people management experience leading high-performing compliance teams.</li> <li>Deep technical knowledge of AML/financial crime regulation (FATF, EU AML Directives, UK POCA, US BSA/AML), PEP/sanctions frameworks, Code of Ethics programs, and conflicts management.</li> <li>Strong management, operational, and process-improvement skills with a track record of designing scalable, repeatable compliance processes and controls.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with regulators, senior management, and internal stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong analytical and judgment skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, assess risk, and escalate appropriately.</li> <li>Firm and team first in thinking.</li> </ul> <p><strong>We'd love if you had:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Previously held SMF16/17 designation.</li> <li>Experience operating within or leading a Center of Excellence or center-led compliance model.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools and compliance technology platforms (e.g. Microsoft Copilot, Power Automate, or similar) to enhance program efficiency.</li> <li>Relevant professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA Diploma, or similar.</li> <li>Familiarity with the multi-manager or alternative investment management model.</li> <li>Experience leading regulatory engagement and change management across multiple EU jurisdictions.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p></p> <p><strong><u>Who We Are</u></strong></p> <p>Schonfeld is a global multi-manager hedge fund that strives to deliver industry-leading risk-adjusted returns for our investors. We leverage both internal and external portfolio manager teams around the world, seeking to capitalize on inefficiencies and opportunities within the markets. We draw from decades of experience and a significant investment in proprietary technology, infrastructure and risk analytics to invest across four main strategies: Quant, Tactical, Fundamental Equity and Discretionary Macro &amp; Fixed Income.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><u>Our Culture</u></strong></p> <p>At Schonfeld, we’ll invest in you. Attracting and retaining top talent is at the heart of what we do, because we believe that exceptional outcomes begin with exceptional people. We foster a culture where talent is empowered to continually learn, innovate and pursue ambitious goals. We are teamwork-oriented, collaborative and encourage ideas—at all levels—to be shared. As an organization committed to investing in our people, we provide learning and educational offerings and opportunities to make an impact. We encourage community through internal networks, external partnerships and service initiatives that promote inclusion and purpose beyond the firm’s walls.</p> <p>#LI-DC1</p> <p></p> <p><span id="__symantecMPKIClientDetector" style="display: none;">__PRESENT</span></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</em></p> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p><strong>What does an UK- New Business Director&nbsp;do at WPP Production?</strong>&nbsp;<br><strong> </strong>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The role</strong></p> <p>The New Business Director plays a pivotal role in shaping and driving growth for WPP Production, <strong>defining how we win high-value, complex opportunities and shaping the strategic direction of our UK growth function</strong>.</p> <p>You will lead the strategic direction and narrative for priority new business opportunities, <strong>designing integrated solutions and clear go-to-market propositions.&nbsp; </strong>You will ensure that every response (whether formal RFP or informal approach) is clearly positioned, commercially compelling and aligned to client needs. You will be accountable for the <strong>quality and consistency of our narrative and strategic output across all UK pitches</strong>, setting the standard for how we articulate our value.</p> <p>Working closely with senior stakeholders across WPP Production and the wider WPP network, you will play a key role in <strong>driving integration across Media, Creative and Production</strong>, shaping how we bring together capabilities to deliver differentiated client solutions.</p> <p>Beyond individual opportunities, you will take a broader view of growth — <strong>defining where we should focus, how we prioritise opportunities, and how we scale success globally</strong>. This includes evolving our approach to pitches, refining commercial models and embedding best practice ways of working across the team.</p> <p>This is a high-impact role with visibility across the whole UK business, suited to someone who thrives in the fast-paced world of new business, operates with a high level of autonomy, and is motivated by driving measurable growth and business impact at scale.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Key areas of responsibility:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and lead the strategic direction for priority, high-value opportunities, ensuring a clear and differentiated approach to winning</li> <li>Accountable for the narrative quality and strategic standard across all pitches, setting the benchmark for how we articulate our value</li> <li>Design pipeline, performance and market trends to identify where growth is coming from — and where it should come from next</li> <li>Partner with senior leadership to shape growth priorities, targets and senior stakeholders across WPP and key client organisations</li> <li>Develop and scale team capability, through coaching, mentoring and training</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong>What good looks
